title: Private Rust AuthenticatedFrame fields break lichen-node all-features build
description: Final Rule/version correctness review: making AuthenticatedFrame fields private in rust/lichen-link/src/link_layer.rs:197-202 was not migrated in rust/lichen-node/src/stack.rs:503-515 and rust/lichen-node/src/rpl_stack/receive.rs:104-184,238-325. cargo check -p lichen-node --all-features --locked fails with 19 E0616 errors. Replace direct field access with payload(), sender(), epoch(), and seqnum() while preserving detached evidence semantics; run lichen-node all-feature check/tests plus affected workspace consumers.
